narrative.overview: RideNote looks like a control-room desk at night. The page is a near-black glass; every group of information sits in a flat, etched panel; labels are small mono capitals; values are mono; and one lit blue marks what you can act on. Each field has a label, a value, or an honest blank.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners, 1px etched borders, flat panels.
Three voices: condensed caps for headings and keys, mono for data and labels, a humanist sans for reading text.
One accent. Amber and red are reserved for Missing and errors.
Unstated fields are dashed blank slots reading Not stated, never styled like data.

rules.name: The Blank Is Not Data Rule
rules.body: An unstated field is a dashed Edge underline and the words Not stated in italic dim text. It never takes the value style, a placeholder dash, or the accent.

rules.name: The One Lit Colour Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only colour that says this is live or chosen. Amber and red say missing and failed and are never used for emphasis.

rules.name: The Edge Rule
rules.body: Anything a person must see to find or operate a control uses Edge (3:1 or better); Etch tones are scenery.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Measurements Rule
rules.body: Mono carries entered text, field values, times, counts and labels; reading copy never uses it.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: Panels never cast shadows. If something looks raised, it is a key.

dos: Do keep every corner square and every panel flat.
Do use Edge (#63758b) for any border that identifies an input or an empty slot.
Do show absence as the dashed Not stated slot.
Do use the accent for action, selection and identified aids only.
Do keep all controls at least 44px tall and give them a 2px accent focus outline.
Do wrap decorative motion in motion-safe:; the loading skeleton is the model.
donts: Don't use rounded corners, pills or white card surfaces; that is the retired earlier design.
Don't put a light/dark class pair on an element; the app is dark-only, so use the dark value directly.
Don't use Etch or Etch Strong for a border a person needs to see.
Don't colour a Missing field in the accent, or style a blank like a value.
Don't add shadows to panels; only keys have them.
Don't use the mono face for reading paragraphs.
Don't hard-code a colour in a component; add or reuse a token in app/globals.css.
